continuation.final_observation: ACCEPT iff the complete remaining word avoids SINK; otherwise REJECT
continuation.semantics: exact algebraic transport; a move succeeds iff the whole transported form is regular on the target chart
continuation.sink: one absorbing verification-only SINK after failed regularity; not an algebraic/world state

source.frame_convention: e_i = X_i^m on U_i; e_i=(X_i/X_j)^m e_j on U_i∩U_j
source.local_basis: on U_i use d(X_k/X_i) for the two k!=i in ascending homogeneous-index order
source.regularity: a transported twisted one-form is regular on U_i iff both exact Laurent-polynomial coefficients in the declared Kaehler basis have no negative exponent after full algebraic cancellation
source.seed_exponent_window: r,s in {0,...,B}; polynomial/root-regular window frozen before quotient success evaluation
source.seed_formula: x^r y^s times one of dx, dy, (dx+dy), (y dx - x dy), tensored with e_0
